paper_title: Identification of Cardiometabolic Protein Biomarkers for Acute Myocardial Infarction Using Olink Proteomics
study_design: Single-center cross-sectional targeted plasma-proteomics discovery and additional plasma ELISA assessment, followed by separate public gene-expression ROC and two-sample MR analyses. Coronary blood was collected before angiography, processed in Na-EDTA tubes at 3000g for 15 minutes at 4C and stored at -80C.
evidence_type: Targeted proximity extension assay; orthogonal ELISA; Pearson correlation; GO/KEGG enrichment; STRING/Cytoscape network analysis; public gene-expression ROC; exploratory MR.
claim: Targeted plasma profiling identified an AMI-associated cardiometabolic protein signature.
context: Olink Cardiometabolic panel discovery in patients with AMI and healthy controls.
reported_evidence: [{"label":"Discovery cohort","value":"20 AMI patients and 10 healthy controls"},{"label":"Assay coverage","value":"92 predefined proteins; proximity extension assay with log2 Normalized Protein eXpression (NPX)"},{"label":"Differential-protein set","value":"32 proteins at the Results-reported p<0.05 threshold: 12 higher and 20 lower in AMI"},{"label":"Statistical reporting","value":"Methods specify Benjamini-Hochberg FDR<0.05 for differential expression; the Results do not show an adjusted p-value for each of the 32 reported proteins"}]
source_locator: Materials and Methods: Screening of Cardiometabolic Biomarkers for AMI; Statistical Analysis. Results: Identification of Cardiometabolic-Related Biomarkers Using Olink; Figures 1C-D and 2A-C.
scope_does_not_establish: ["Prospective early-detection performance, a clinical decision threshold, incremental value over standard cardiac biomarkers or improved patient outcomes.","External plasma-proteomic transportability from public gene-expression ROC analyses.","Causal mechanisms or treatment benefit from protein correlations/enrichment, or definitive causality from nominal method-dependent MR estimates."]
limitations: ["The Olink discovery set contains 20 AMI cases and 10 healthy controls from a single center; prospective and multicenter diagnostic performance was not evaluated.","Methods/Table 1 specify 125 AMI participants for ELISA, whereas the Figure 5 caption specifies 120; the analyzed figure-specific sample count is unresolved.","The body/Figure 5 GSE57388 label differs from Table S1 GSE57338; DEFA1 is absent from the ICM datasets, and expression-data ROC is a different evidence modality from plasma ELISA.","Methods specify FDR correction for differential expression, while the Results identify the 32-protein set using p<0.05 without a per-protein adjusted-value mapping.","The FCN2 and DEFA1 MR associations are nominal and estimator-dependent; exposure units, precise source-instrument mapping and multiplicity handling are insufficiently specified for a definitive causal claim."]
single_finding_matrix_scope: ["Olink Cardiometabolic panel discovery in patients with AMI and healthy controls."]
export_notice: Study-level author-maintained evidence summary. Not participant-level data and not a ready-to-pool meta-analysis dataset. For formal citation, use the original article DOI.
